ĠthatĠtakesĠaĠnumberĠandĠaddsĠtheĠoffset.ĠThen,ĠI'llĠapplyĠthisĠhelperĠtwiceĠtoĠtheĠvalue.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠhelperĠfunctionĠisĠ(x:ĠType)Ġ=>ĠxĠ+Ġoffset,ĠbutĠIĠneedĠtoĠmakeĠsureĠthatĠtheĠtypesĠareĠcorrect,ĠprobablyĠintegersĠsinceĠwe'reĠaddingĠanĠoffset.ĊĊNow,ĠapplyingĠtheĠhelperĠtwice:Ġfirst,ĠapplyĠitĠtoĠtheĠvalue,ĠwhichĠgivesĠusĠvalueĠ+Ġoffset.ĠThen,ĠapplyĠitĠagainĠtoĠthatĠresult,ĠwhichĠgivesĠ(valueĠ+Ġoffset)Ġ+Ġoffset,ĠorĠvalueĠ+Ġ2*offset.ĊĊButĠsinceĠtheĠlanguageĠallowsĠforĠexpressions,ĠmaybeĠIĠdon'tĠneedĠtoĠdefineĠtheĠhelperĠexplicitlyĠandĠcanĠjustĠapplyĠtheĠlambdaĠtwiceĠdirectly.ĠHowever,ĠtheĠtaskĠmentionsĠbuildingĠaĠhelper,ĠsoĠIĠthinkĠdefiningĠitĠexplicitlyĠisĠbetter.ĊĊPuttingĠthisĠintoĠcode,ĠIĠcanĠwrite:ĊĊletĠapplyTwiceOffsetĠ=Ġ(offset,Ġvalue)Ġ=>Ġ{ĊĠĠĠĠletĠhelperĠ=Ġ(x:ĠType)Ġ=>ĠxĠ+Ġoffset;ĊĠĠĠĠhelper(helper(value))Ċ};ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠinĠtheĠgivenĠlanguage,ĠvariablesĠareĠscopedĠbyĠletĠandĠlambda.ĠSo,ĠIĠneedĠtoĠdefineĠtheĠhelperĠinsideĠapplyTwiceOffset.ĠLetĠmeĠstructureĠitĠproperly.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠIĠcanĠwriteĠtheĠhelperĠasĠaĠlambdaĠinsideĠtheĠmainĠfunction.ĠMaybeĠlike:ĊĊ(Ġ(offset,Ġvalue)Ġ=>ĠĊĠĠĠĠ(Ġ(x:ĠType)Ġ=>ĠxĠ+ĠoffsetĠ)ĠĊĠĠĠĠ(Ġ(x:ĠType)Ġ=>ĠxĠ+ĠoffsetĠ)Ġ(value)ĠĊ);ĊĊButĠthatĠseemsĠaĠbitĠconvoluted.ĠAlternatively,ĠIĠcanĠwriteĠitĠas:ĊĊ(Ġ(offset,Ġvalue)Ġ=>ĠĊĠĠĠĠ(Ġ(x)Ġ=>ĠxĠ+ĠoffsetĠ)Ġ(Ġ(x)Ġ=>ĠxĠ+ĠoffsetĠ)Ġ(value)ĠĊ);ĊĊButĠIĠthinkĠtheĠfirstĠapproachĠwithĠletĠisĠclearer.ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠinĠtheĠgivenĠlanguage,ĠvariablesĠareĠscopedĠinsideĠletĠandĠlambda,ĠsoĠIĠneedĠtoĠmakeĠsureĠthatĠtheĠhelperĠisĠproperlyĠscopedĠwithinĠapplyTwiceOffset.ĊĊPuttingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠformalĠblockĠwouldĠdefineĠtheĠfunctionĠwithĠtheĠhelperĠinside.ĊĊWait,ĠI'mĠaĠbitĠconfusedĠaboutĠtheĠexactĠsyntax.ĠLetĠmeĠthinkĠagain.ĊĊTheĠfunctionĠshouldĠtakeĠanĠoffsetĠandĠaĠvalue,ĠthenĠapplyĠtheĠhelperĠtwice.ĠTheĠhelperĠisĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠxĠandĠreturnsĠxĠ+Ġoffset.ĊĊSo,ĠinsideĠapplyTwiceOffset,ĠIĠcanĠdefineĠtheĠhelperĠasĠaĠletĠbinding,ĠandĠthenĠapplyĠitĠtwice.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠcodeĠwouldĠlookĠlike:ĊĊletĠapplyTwiceOffsetĠ=Ġ(offs amplesĠgiven,ĠIĠseeĠ'letĠ...Ġ=Ġ...'ĠandĠ'lambda'Ġexpressions,ĠsoĠmaybeĠ'fn'ĠisĠacceptableĠhere.ĊĊWait,ĠlookingĠbackĠatĠtheĠinitialĠtask,ĠtheĠexamplesĠshowedĠusingĠ'let'ĠforĠdefinitionsĠandĠlambdas.ĠSo,ĠperhapsĠIĠshouldĠstickĠwithĠ'lambda'ĠforĠtheĠhigher-orderĠfunction.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠhigher-orderĠfunctionĠcanĠbeĠwrittenĠasĠaĠlambdaĠthatĠtakesĠf1,Ġf2,Ġf3,ĠandĠreturnsĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠx,ĠappliesĠf1,ĠthenĠf2,ĠthenĠf3.ĊĊPuttingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠcodeĠwouldĠlookĠlike:ĊĊcompose3Ġ=ĠlambdaĠ(f1,Ġf2,Ġf3)Ġ=>ĠlambdaĠ(x)Ġ=>Ġf3Ġ(f2Ġ(f1Ġx))ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠaboutĠtheĠsyntaxĠinĠtheĠlanguage.ĠLetĠmeĠcheckĠtheĠinitialĠexamplesĠagain.ĠTheyĠusedĠ'lambda'Ġexpressions,ĠsoĠmaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠuseĠtheĠkeywordĠ'lambda'ĠfollowedĠbyĠtheĠparametersĠandĠtheĠbody.ĊĊWait,ĠinĠtheĠexamples,ĠtheĠuserĠwrote:ĊĊlambda:Ġ(x:Type)=>body.ĊĊSo,ĠperhapsĠtheĠsyntaxĠisĠtoĠuseĠ'lambda'Ġkeyword,ĠspecifyĠtheĠparameters,ĠandĠthenĠtheĠbody.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠfunctionĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊlambdaĠ(f1,Ġf2,Ġf3:Ġ(intĠ->Ġint)Ġ->Ġ(intĠ->Ġint)Ġ->Ġ(intĠ->Ġint))Ġ=>ĠlambdaĠ(x:Ġint)Ġ=>Ġf3Ġ(f2Ġ(f1Ġx))ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠaboutĠtheĠtypesĠforĠtheĠparametersĠf1,Ġf2,Ġf3.ĠSinceĠeachĠisĠaĠfunctionĠfromĠintĠtoĠint,ĠtheirĠtypeĠwouldĠbeĠintĠ->Ġint.ĠSo,ĠtheĠfunctionĠcompose3ĠtakesĠthreeĠfunctions,ĠeachĠofĠtypeĠintĠ->Ġint,ĠandĠreturnsĠaĠfunctionĠofĠtypeĠintĠ->Ġint.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠtypeĠannotationĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊcompose3:Ġ(intĠ->Ġint)Ġ->Ġ(intĠ->Ġint)Ġ->Ġ(intĠ->Ġint)Ġ->ĠintĠ->ĠintĊĊButĠinĠtheĠlambdaĠexpression,ĠIĠcanĠomitĠtheĠtypeĠannotationsĠforĠtheĠparametersĠexceptĠforĠx,ĠsinceĠtheĠparametersĠf1,Ġf2,Ġf3ĠareĠallĠintĠ->ĠintĠbyĠtheĠwayĠthey'reĠused.ĊĊSo,ĠputtingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠcodeĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊcompose3Ġ=ĠlambdaĠ(f1,Ġf2,Ġf3)Ġ=>ĠlambdaĠ(x)Ġ=>Ġf3Ġ(f2Ġ(f1Ġx))ĊĊButĠsinceĠinĠtheĠexamples,ĠtheĠuserĠusedĠ'lambda:Ġ(x:Type)=>body',ĠmaybeĠtheĠsyntaxĠisĠtoĠspecifyĠtheĠtypesĠasĠwell.ĊĊSo,Ġperhaps:ĊĊcompose3Ġ=ĠlambdaĠ(f1:Ġ(intĠ->Ġint),Ġf2:Ġ(intĠ->Ġint),Ġf3:Ġ(intĠ->Ġint))Ġ=>ĠlambdaĠ(x:Ġint)Ġ=>Ġf3Ġ(f2Ġ(f1Ġx))ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠentirelyĠsureĠifĠtheĠlanguageĠrequiresĠexplicitĠtypeĠannotationsĠforĠtheĠparameters.ĠInĠML-likeĠlanguages,ĠtypeĠannotationsĠareĠoftenĠoptional,ĠespeciallyĠforĠtop-levelĠfunctions,ĠbutĠit'sĠsaferĠtoĠincludeĠthemĠtoĠmakeĠtheĠcodeĠself-contained.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠmaybeĠtheĠhigher-orderĠfunctionĠisĠwrittenĠasĠaĠnestedĠlambda.ĊĊWait,ĠperhapsĠIĠcanĠwriteĠitĠas:ĊĊcompose3Ġ=ĠlambdaĠxĠ=>ĠlambdaĠf1Ġ=>ĠlambdaĠf2Ġ=>ĠlambdaĠf3Ġ=>Ġf3Ġ(f2Ġ(f1Ġx))ĊĊButĠno,Ġthat'sĠaĠdifferentĠorder.ĠTheĠuserĠwantsĠf3ĠappliedĠfirst,ĠthenĠf2,ĠthenĠf1.ĠSo,Ġf3Ġ(f2Ġ(f1Ġx))ĠisĠcorrect.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠperhapsĠtheĠfunctionĠcanĠbeĠwrittenĠmoreĠconciselyĠusingĠfunctionĠapplicationĠwithoutĠextraĠlambdaĠlayers.ĠButĠIĠthinkĠtheĠwayĠIĠhaveĠitĠisĠcorrect.ĊĊWait,ĠletĠmeĠtestĠit.ĠIfĠIĠhaveĠcompose3ĠappliedĠtoĠf1,Ġf2,Ġf3,ĠandĠthenĠx,ĠitĠshouldĠexecuteĠasĠf3Ġ(f2Ġ(f1Ġx)).ĠSo,ĠtheĠlambdaĠshouldĠtakeĠf1,Ġf2,Ġf3,ĠandĠreturnĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠxĠandĠappliesĠthemĠinĠorder.ĊĊYes,ĠthatĠseemsĠright.ĊĊSo,ĠtoĠwriteĠitĠinĠtheĠgivenĠlanguage'sĠsyntax,ĠusingĠ'lambda'ĠasĠtheĠkeywordĠforĠanonymousĠfunctions,ĠandĠdefiningĠcompose3ĠasĠaĠlambdaĠthatĠtakesĠthreeĠfunctionsĠandĠreturnsĠaĠlambdaĠthatĠtakesĠxĠandĠappliesĠf1,ĠthenĠf2,ĠthenĠf3.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠcodeĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊcompose3Ġ=ĠlambdaĠ(f1,Ġf2,Ġf3)Ġ=>ĠlambdaĠ(x)Ġ=>Ġf3Ġ(f2Ġ(f1Ġx))ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠifĠtheĠlanguageĠrequiresĠtheĠparametersĠtoĠbeĠexplicitlyĠtypedĠasĠintĠ->Ġint.ĠTheĠinitialĠexamplesĠdidn'tĠincludeĠtypeĠannotations,ĠsoĠmaybeĠit'sĠacceptableĠtoĠomitĠthem.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠifĠIĠneedĠtoĠspecifyĠtheĠtypes,ĠIĠcanĠwrite:ĊĊcompose3Ġ=ĠlambdaĠ(f1:Ġ(intĠ->Ġint),Ġf2:Ġ(intĠ->Ġint),Ġf3:Ġ(intĠ->Ġint))Ġ=>ĠlambdaĠ(x:Ġint)Ġ=>Ġf3Ġ(f2Ġ(f1Ġx))ĊĊButĠagain,ĠtheĠexamplesĠdidn'tĠshowĠtypeĠannotations,ĠsoĠperhapsĠit'sĠbetterĠtoĠomitĠthemĠunlessĠtheĠtypeĠsystemĠrequiresĠit.ĊĊIĠthinkĠtheĠsimplestĠwayĠisĠtoĠwriteĠitĠwithoutĠtypeĠannotationsĠforĠtheĠparameters,ĠasĠit'sĠaĠhigher-orderĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠfunctionsĠandĠreturnsĠaĠfunction,ĠandĠtheĠfunctionsĠareĠalreadyĠexpectedĠtoĠbeĠintĠ->Ġint.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠfinalĠcodeĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊcompose3Ġ=ĠlambdaĠ(f1,Ġf2,Ġf3)Ġ=>ĠlambdaĠ(x)Ġ= tiontwiceĠtoĠtheĠvalue,ĠandĠthenĠreturnstwiceĠasĠthefinalexpression."ĠHmm,ĠmaybeĠ"twiceĠasĠtheĠfinalĠexpression"ĠmeansĠreturnĠtheĠvalueĠappliedĠtwice,ĠbutĠthatĠdoesn'tĠquiteĠmakeĠsense.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠmaybeĠit'sĠaĠtranslationĠissue,ĠandĠitĠjustĠmeansĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtwice.ĠSo,ĠperhapsĠtheĠcorrectĠapproachĠisĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtwiceĠtoĠxĠandĠreturnĠthatĠresult.ĊĊSo,ĠputtingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠhigher-orderĠfunctionĠwouldĠtakeĠfĠandĠx,ĠapplyĠfĠtwiceĠtoĠx,ĠandĠreturnĠtheĠresult.ĊĊInĠML,ĠvariablesĠareĠscopedĠbyĠletĠbindings,ĠandĠIĠcanĠstructureĠitĠas:ĊĊletĠapply_twiceĠ=ĠfunĠfĠ=>ĠfunĠxĠ=>ĠfĠ(fĠx)ĊĊButĠtheĠproblemĠwantsĠtheĠfunctionĠtoĠreturnĠtwiceĠtheĠfinalĠexpression.ĠSo,ĠperhapsĠIĠneedĠtoĠmultiplyĠtheĠresultĠbyĠtwo.ĠSo,ĠitĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊletĠapply_twiceĠ=ĠfunĠfĠxĠ=>Ġ2Ġ*ĠfĠ(fĠx)ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠfunctionsĠinĠMLĠareĠcurriedĠbyĠdefault,ĠsoĠIĠcanĠalsoĠwriteĠitĠasĠfunĠfĠ=>ĠfunĠxĠ=>Ġ2Ġ*ĠfĠ(fĠx),ĠwhichĠisĠmoreĠconcise.ĊĊLetĠmeĠalsoĠconsiderĠtheĠtypes.ĠfĠisĠintĠ->Ġint,ĠxĠisĠint,ĠsoĠfĠ(fĠx)ĠisĠint,ĠandĠmultiplyingĠbyĠ2ĠgivesĠint.ĠSoĠtheĠtypesĠareĠconsistent.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠperhapsĠtheĠfunctionĠisĠsupposedĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtwiceĠandĠreturnĠtheĠresult,ĠbutĠthenĠtheĠsecondĠpartĠisĠconfusing.ĠMaybeĠtheĠ"twiceĠasĠtheĠfinalĠexpression"ĠrefersĠtoĠapplyingĠtheĠfunctionĠtwiceĠandĠthenĠreturningĠtwiceĠtheĠresult.ĊĊButĠIĠthinkĠtheĠprimaryĠinstructionĠisĠtoĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtwiceĠandĠreturnĠtheĠresult.ĠSo,ĠI'llĠproceedĠwithĠthat.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠfinalĠcodeĠwouldĠbeĠaĠhigher-orderĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠfunctionĠfĠandĠaĠvalueĠx,ĠappliesĠfĠtwiceĠtoĠx,ĠandĠreturnsĠtheĠresult.ĊĊHere'sĠhowĠIĠcanĠwriteĠit:ĊĊletĠapply_twiceĠ=ĠfunĠfĠ=>ĠfunĠxĠ=>ĠfĠ(fĠx)ĊĊAlternatively,ĠusingĠletĠbinding:ĊĊletĠapply_twiceĠ=ĠletĠapply_twiceĠ=Ġ(funĠfĠ=>Ġ(funĠxĠ=>ĠfĠ(fĠx)))ĠinĠapply_twiceĊĊButĠinĠML,ĠtheĠfirstĠapproachĠisĠsufficient.ĊĊIĠthinkĠthisĠshouldĠsolveĠtheĠproblem.ĠLetĠmeĠtestĠitĠwithĠanĠexample.ĠSupposeĠfĠisĠtheĠfunctionĠthatĠaddsĠ1:Ġf(x)Ġ=ĠxĠ+Ġ1.ĠIfĠIĠapplyĠapply_twiceĠfĠtoĠ5,ĠitĠshouldĠgiveĠmeĠ7.ĠLet'sĠsee:Ġf(f(5))Ġ=Ġf(6)Ġ=Ġ7.ĠCorrect.ĊĊIfĠfĠisĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠsquares,ĠthenĠf(f(2))Ġ=Ġ(2^2)^2Ġ=Ġ16,ĠwhichĠisĠcorrect.ĊĊSo,ĠIĠthinkĠthisĠshouldĠwork.Ċ

resultĠofĠf,ĠwhichĠisĠaĠBool,ĠandĠreturnĠtheĠoriginalĠInt.ĠSo,Ġessentially,ĠI'mĠjustĠignoringĠtheĠBoolĠandĠreturningĠtheĠInt.ĊĊPuttingĠthisĠtogether,ĠtheĠtermĠshouldĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtoĠtheĠInt,ĠbutĠthenĠsomehowĠdiscardĠtheĠBoolĠresult.ĠSo,ĠtheĠstructureĠwouldĠbe:ĠtakeĠfĠandĠx,ĠapplyĠfĠtoĠx,ĠandĠthenĠreturnĠx.ĠButĠwait,ĠtheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠignoreĠtheĠfunction,ĠsoĠperhapsĠIĠshouldĠapplyĠfĠtoĠxĠandĠthenĠreturnĠx,ĠeffectivelyĠignoringĠtheĠBoolĠresult.ĊĊSo,Ġformally,ĠtheĠtermĠwouldĠbe:ĠÎ»f.Î»x.(fĠx).ĠButĠsinceĠwe'reĠsupposedĠtoĠignoreĠtheĠfunction'sĠresult,ĠmaybeĠweĠdon'tĠevenĠneedĠtoĠapplyĠit.ĠWait,Ġno,ĠweĠstillĠneedĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtoĠxĠtoĠgetĠtheĠBool,ĠbutĠthenĠignoreĠit.ĠSo,ĠtoĠignoreĠtheĠBool,ĠperhapsĠIĠneedĠtoĠprovideĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠdiscardsĠitsĠresult.ĠAlternatively,ĠmaybeĠIĠcanĠjustĠreturnĠxĠdirectly,ĠbutĠthatĠseemsĠtooĠstraightforward.ĠHowever,ĠtheĠtermĠalreadyĠappliesĠfĠtoĠx,ĠwhichĠresultsĠinĠaĠBool,ĠbutĠthenĠweĠreturnĠx,ĠeffectivelyĠignoringĠtheĠBool.ĊĊWait,Ġno,ĠtheĠtermĠisĠÎ»f.Î»x.Ġx.ĠThatĠwouldĠmeanĠthatĠweĠignoreĠtheĠfunctionĠfĠandĠjustĠreturnĠx.ĠButĠthen,ĠwhyĠapplyĠfĠtoĠxĠatĠall?ĠTheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtwice,ĠonceĠtoĠgetĠtheĠBool,ĠthenĠdoĠsomethingĠwithĠit.ĠButĠinĠthisĠcase,ĠsinceĠweĠdon'tĠneedĠtheĠBool,ĠmaybeĠtheĠtermĠcanĠbeĠÎ»f.Î»x.Ġx,ĠwhichĠeffectivelyĠdiscardsĠtheĠfunctionĠapplication.ĊĊButĠtheĠproblemĠstatementĠsaysĠtoĠtakeĠaĠfunctionĠandĠanĠInt,ĠandĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtwice.ĠSoĠperhapsĠit'sĠexpectingĠsomethingĠlikeĠÎ»f.Î»x.ĠfĠ(fĠx).ĠButĠthatĠwouldĠapplyĠfĠtwice,ĠwhichĠmightĠnotĠbeĠnecessaryĠhere.ĠAlternatively,ĠmaybeĠI'mĠovercomplicatingĠit.ĠTheĠrequirementĠisĠtoĠignoreĠtheĠfunction'sĠresultĠandĠreturnĠtheĠoriginalĠInt.ĠSo,ĠperhapsĠtheĠsimplestĠwayĠisĠtoĠreturnĠxĠwithoutĠusingĠtheĠfunctionĠatĠall,ĠwhichĠwouldĠbeĠÎ»f.Î»x.Ġx.ĊĊButĠwait,ĠdoesĠthatĠcountĠasĠignoringĠtheĠfunction?ĠYes,ĠbecauseĠxĠisĠreturnedĠasĠis,ĠregardlessĠofĠf.ĠSo,ĠtheĠtermĠisĠÎ»f.Î»x.Ġx,ĠwhichĠtakesĠfĠandĠx,ĠandĠreturnsĠx,ĠeffectivelyĠignoringĠbothĠtheĠfunctionĠandĠtheĠ ĠaĠfunctionĠfromĠIntĠtoĠBool.ĠSoĠifĠIĠapplyĠxĠtoĠg,ĠIĠgetĠaĠBool.ĠButĠthenĠIĠcanĠpassĠthatĠBoolĠtoĠf,ĠbutĠfĠexpectsĠaĠBoolĠasĠtheĠsecondĠargument,ĠnotĠasĠaĠfunction.ĊĊWait,ĠmaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠcomposeĠgĠandĠfĠsomehow.ĠMaybeĠapplyĠgĠxĠtoĠfĠ(x).ĠButĠfĠexpectsĠaĠBool,ĠnotĠaĠfunction.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠperhapsĠtheĠtermĠshouldĠbeĠsomethingĠlikeĠfĠ(x)Ġ(gĠx).ĠSoĠxĠisĠappliedĠtoĠfĠfirst,ĠgivingĠaĠBool->IntĠfunction,ĠandĠthenĠgĠxĠisĠaĠBoolĠwhichĠisĠthenĠappliedĠtoĠthatĠfunctionĠtoĠgetĠanĠInt.ĠSoĠtheĠresultĠwouldĠbeĠtheĠsameĠasĠfĠxĠ(gĠx).ĠButĠdoesĠthatĠsatisfyĠfeedingĠxĠintoĠbothĠtheĠcurriedĠfunctionĠandĠtheĠBool-producingĠfunction?ĊĊIĠthinkĠso,ĠbecauseĠxĠisĠtheĠargumentĠtoĠf,ĠandĠalsoĠtheĠargumentĠtoĠg,ĠwhichĠisĠthenĠusedĠasĠtheĠsecondĠargumentĠtoĠf.ĠSoĠyes,ĠxĠisĠusedĠinĠbothĠplaces.ĊĊSoĠputtingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠlambdaĠtermĠwouldĠbeĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠf,ĠthenĠg,ĠthenĠx,ĠandĠappliesĠfĠtoĠxĠandĠgĠx.ĠSoĠinĠnotation,ĠitĠwouldĠbeĠ(Î»f.Ġ(Î»g.Ġ(Î»x.ĠfĠxĠ(gĠx)))).ĊĊIĠthinkĠthat'sĠit.ĠLetĠmeĠcheckĠagain.ĠfĠtakesĠanĠInt,ĠthenĠaĠBool,ĠsoĠxĠisĠtheĠInt,ĠandĠgĠxĠisĠtheĠBool.ĠSoĠfĠxĠ(gĠx)ĠshouldĠwork,ĠgivingĠtheĠfinalĠInt.ĠAndĠthisĠlambdaĠtermĠcapturesĠthatĠstructure.Ċ

teĠf(x,ĠBx)Ġsomehow.ĠButĠsinceĠfĠisĠcurried,Ġit'sĠf(x)ĠthenĠ(Bx).ĊĊButĠtheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtwice,ĠsoĠmaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtwice:ĠfirstĠtoĠx,ĠgettingĠaĠBool->Int,ĠthenĠapplyĠB(x)ĠtoĠthat.ĠAlternatively,ĠmaybeĠIĠshouldĠfirstĠapplyĠBĠtoĠx,ĠgettingĠaĠBool,ĠthenĠpassĠthatĠtoĠfĠafterĠx.ĊĊWait,ĠI'mĠaĠbitĠconfused.ĠLetĠmeĠtryĠtoĠoutlineĠtheĠsteps:ĊĊ1.ĠTakeĠf:ĠIntĠ->ĠBoolĠ->ĠIntĊ2.ĠTakeĠT:ĠIntĠ->ĠIntĊ3.ĠTakeĠB:ĠIntĠ->ĠBoolĊ4.ĠTakeĠx:ĠIntĊĊThen,ĠIĠneedĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtwice.ĠMaybeĠlikeĠf(Tx)(Bx),ĠbutĠthatĠseemsĠlikeĠjustĠoneĠapplication.ĠAlternatively,ĠapplyĠfĠtoĠTxĠandĠthenĠtoĠBx?ĠButĠfĠexpectsĠanĠIntĠfollowedĠbyĠaĠBool.ĠSo,ĠmaybeĠfirstĠapplyĠfĠtoĠTx,ĠwhichĠgivesĠBool->Int,ĠthenĠapplyĠBxĠtoĠthat.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠtermĠwouldĠbeĠfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx).ĠThatĠwouldĠuseĠfĠtwiceĠinĠaĠway:ĠonceĠwithĠTĠx,ĠthenĠwithĠBĠx.ĊĊWait,Ġno,ĠfĠisĠappliedĠonce,ĠtakingĠTĠxĠandĠthenĠBĠxĠasĠarguments.ĠButĠtheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtwice.ĠMaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtoĠxĠfirst,ĠthenĠtoĠBx,ĠandĠthenĠagain?ĠThatĠdoesn'tĠmakeĠmuchĠsense.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠperhapsĠIĠneedĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtoĠx,ĠthenĠapplyĠtheĠresultĠtoĠBx,ĠandĠthenĠdoĠsomethingĠelseĠwithĠthat.ĠButĠthatĠseemsĠaĠbitĠunclear.ĊĊLetĠmeĠtryĠtoĠstructureĠthis.ĊĊTheĠtermĠshouldĠtakeĠf,ĠT,ĠB,ĠandĠx.ĠThen,ĠitĠshouldĠapplyĠfĠtoĠx,ĠgettingĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠanĠInt.ĠThen,ĠapplyĠB(x)ĠtoĠthat,ĠbutĠwait,ĠB(x)ĠisĠaĠBool,ĠsoĠmaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtwiceĠinĠsomeĠway.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠmaybeĠtheĠtermĠisĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtoĠTĠxĠandĠthenĠtoĠBĠx,ĠwhichĠwouldĠbeĠfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx).ĠButĠthatĠseemsĠlikeĠjustĠpassingĠbothĠargumentsĠtoĠfĠonce.ĊĊHmm,ĠperhapsĠtheĠconfusionĠcomesĠfromĠhowĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtwice.ĠMaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠfirstĠapplyĠfĠtoĠx,ĠgettingĠaĠBool->Int,ĠthenĠapplyĠB(x)ĠtoĠthat,ĠresultingĠinĠanĠInt,ĠandĠthenĠdoĠsomethingĠelseĠwithĠthat.ĊĊButĠtheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtwice,ĠsoĠmaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠpassĠbothĠTĠxĠandĠBĠxĠtoĠfĠinĠsomeĠway.ĠLetĠmeĠthinkĠaboutĠtheĠstructure.ĊĊIĠthinkĠtheĠcorrectĠapproachĠisĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtoĠTĠxĠandĠthenĠtoĠBĠx.ĠSoĠtheĠfinalĠtermĠwouldĠbeĠfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx).ĠButĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠifĠthat'sĠapplyingĠfĠtwiceĠorĠjustĠonce.ĊĊWait,ĠfĠisĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠanĠIntĠandĠreturnsĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠanĠInt.ĠSo,ĠapplyingĠfĠtoĠTĠxĠwouldĠgiveĠmeĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠanĠInt.ĠThen,ĠapplyingĠBĠxĠtoĠthatĠwouldĠgiveĠmeĠanĠInt.ĠSo,Ġoverall,Ġit'sĠapplyingĠfĠonce,ĠbutĠpassingĠbothĠarguments:ĠTĠxĠandĠBĠx.ĊĊButĠtheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtwice,ĠsoĠmaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtwice,ĠlikeĠf(fĠx)Ġsomething.ĠButĠfĠxĠisĠalreadyĠBool->Int,ĠsoĠapplyingĠfĠtoĠxĠwouldĠnotĠmakeĠsenseĠunlessĠfĠisĠappliedĠtwiceĠinĠsomeĠway.ĊĊIĠthinkĠI'mĠovercomplicatingĠthis.ĠMaybeĠtheĠcorrectĠwayĠisĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtoĠTĠxĠandĠBĠx,ĠwhichĠwouldĠmeanĠfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx).ĠThatĠwouldĠuseĠfĠonce,ĠbutĠpassĠbothĠarguments.ĠTheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠapplyĠtheĠfunctionĠtwice,ĠbutĠperhapsĠthat'sĠjustĠaĠwayĠtoĠsayĠthatĠfĠisĠappliedĠonce,ĠbutĠwithĠtwoĠarguments.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠfinalĠtermĠwouldĠbeĠfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx).ĠThatĠfitsĠallĠtheĠrequirements:ĠitĠtakesĠf,ĠT,ĠB,Ġx,ĠandĠappliesĠfĠtoĠTĠxĠandĠBĠx,ĠthenĠcombinesĠtheĠresult.ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠtheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠfeedĠtheĠsameĠIntĠthroughĠbothĠpathsĠbeforeĠcombining.ĠSo,ĠmaybeĠtheĠtermĠisĠfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx),ĠwhichĠusesĠbothĠTĠxĠandĠBĠx,ĠmeaningĠxĠisĠfedĠthroughĠTĠandĠthroughĠBĠbeforeĠapplyingĠf.ĊĊYes,ĠthatĠmakesĠsense.ĠSo,ĠtheĠlambdaĠtermĠwouldĠbeĠfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx).ĊĊSo,ĠputtingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠtermĠis:ĊĊfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx)ĊĊWhichĠinĠlambdaĠcalculusĠwouldĠbeĠwrittenĠasĠfĠTĠxĠBĠx,ĠbutĠsinceĠit'sĠcurried,ĠweĠneedĠtoĠgroupĠtheĠargumentsĠcorrectly.ĊĊWait,Ġno,ĠinĠlambdaĠcalculus,ĠfunctionsĠareĠcurried,ĠsoĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtoĠTĠxĠandĠBĠx,ĠweĠhaveĠtoĠapplyĠfĠtoĠTĠxĠfirst,ĠthenĠtoĠBĠx.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠtermĠisĠ(fĠ(TĠx))Ġ(BĠx).ĊĊButĠsinceĠfĠisĠofĠtypeĠInt->Bool->Int,ĠtheĠcorrectĠgroupingĠwouldĠbeĠfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx).ĊĊSo,ĠinĠtheĠlambdaĠterm,Ġit'sĠfĠ(TĠx)Ġ(BĠx).ĊĊIĠthinkĠthat'sĠtheĠcorrectĠapproach.Ċ
